styleLock.direction: dewy jelly lip-serum pen commerce with rose-metal hardware accents

noDrift: no readable shade numbers or claims
no identity in any face crop
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dewy jelly lip-serum pen ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of peach jelly #F2A08A, rose dew #D97A8E, aqua crystal white #EAF2F4 and milk apricot base #FBF4EE; wet-look beauty light near 6000K with crisp specular chips on gel ridges and glossy lips, one cool glint travelling the rose-metal tip and shadowless boards; glossy gel swirls, rose-gold mirror metal, frosted tube bodies, smooth skin crops and clear water-wave panels only, no marble, no powder textures, no dark stages; one soft rounded sans in plum kept as empty placeholder rails and sparkle rows; lip crops anonymous from the nose down; no color palette changes, no readable shade numbers, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 晶管立姿（玫瑰金圆头）+鼻下高水光唇特写+身后一道透明凝胶涡旋；002 斜置晶管微距，三枚粉色弯箭头引线标注真空按压泵/清凉金属涂抹头/微弧刷头三行英文字；003 模特全脸特写（面孔清晰）压 07# GLOSSY LIP SERUM 与轻薄有色唇油说明；004 四宫格：三格不同肤色鼻下水光唇+一格透明水波纹压 07 LIP SERUM；005 同唇左哑右亮半侧对照（BEFORE/AFTER 粉字）；006 三条不同肤色小臂各叠 01-07 七枚果冻色柱（编号白字）；007 Multi-Effect 标题+MOISTURIZING/GLOSSY/PLUMPING 三行闪光图标说明+右列五枚叠放色膏。品类判定依据：主体为金属按摩头水润肽类有色唇部精华（护理诉求为主、带轻着色），护肤个护下无唇部档，按 taxonomy 归 L1 美妆彩妆、L2 唇部，leaf 记金属头水润肽类有色唇部精华；源类目挂 Skin Care>Lip Care，归档以 taxonomy 为准并记于此。已剥离内容：品牌字样、07# 与 01-07 全部色号编号、GLOSSY LIP SERUM 等英文标题与三行功效说明原句、003 全脸身份（改为鼻下裁切构图），改为空刻度签/空标签轨/空角签/{selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位。与库内五套唇部模版区隔：清水粉温感套无金属头机制与三臂色柱，奶茶棕套为膏体旋转管，本套独有真空按压金属头机制引线、半唇水光对照与五叠色膏栏骨架，色板走蜜桃果冻+玫瑰露暖水光系。源图 7 张，逐图一镜排为 7 镜。
